Title: Retirement: Extended support for Python 3.9 ends October 2025 – upgrade your apps to Python 3.10

Body.Content:
In October 2025, extended support for Python 3.9 will end. Your apps that are hosted on App Service will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for Python 3.9. Learn more about App Service language support.

Learn more.
